name: City Council Special Meeting
minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special Meeting of the City Council

  July 13, 2012

A Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to
order by Mayor Ury at 12:01 p.m., on July 13, 2012, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo,
California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 12:00 p.m. on July 12, 2012, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Schlicht
  Mayor Pro Tem Reardon
  Mayor Ury

Absent:  Council Member Leckness

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Celeste Brady, Special Counsel
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Kelley

INVOCATION: Council Member Schlicht

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Larry Gilbert, M.V.: recommended that the City Council make the residual payment under
protest with the understanding that the money may be recouped later. He stated that he would
rather not see the City go the route of litigation.

CLOSED SESSION

City Council Minutes  1  July 13, 2012
 CS1.  Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation. Initiation of Litigation
  Pursuant to subdivision (c) of Section 54956.9: 1 case – State of California et al.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 12:07 p.m., Mayor Ury recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City Council
reconvened at 12:53 p.m. with four City Council Members present (Council Member Leckness
was absent.)

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that the City Council authorized staff to file an action
against the State of California, the County of Orange, and all relevant taxing agencies to seek a
temporary restraining order to stop the acquisition, by the State, of the City’s Sales and Use
Taxes. The core of the issue surrounds the demand from the State Department of Finance for
$2.6 million from the City through the Successor Agency. Staff believes that the analysis is
incorrect and the amount due is zero. Both State and County staff have agreed with the City’s
calculation but have refused to correct the error or allow the City to appeal. The City will be
asking the court to stop the County or State from taking the City’s Sales and Use Taxes while the
appeals process is completed. The vote on the motion was 4-0 with Council Member Leckness
absent.

At the hour of 12:58 p.m., Mayor Ury left the meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 1:02 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Pro Tem Reardon adjourned the meeting to Monday, August 20, 2012, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of August 20, 2012
